content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High error spike on /v1/generate (US-EAST) — paging oncall (severity: P2)

elena (engops): @samir youre oncall — can you ack and share initial assessment?
samir (oncall): Ack. Investigating now, see elevated 5xxs starting ~11:05 UTC, traces point to a connection storm with a single pool of dedicated GPUs.
lia (incident-commander): Im taking IC. Samir, quick customer impact? (latency vs errors?)
samir (oncall): Mostly 502/504s for requests >1k tokens. Latency for smaller requests intact. Looks capacity-related fallback/queueing issue.
mike (infra): Confirming autoscaler logs show repeated pod churn and one oom-kill in gpu-pool-7 around 11:08. Pulling kernel logs.
elena (engops): Plan: 1) scale dedicated pool up 2) revert recent routing change if its correlated 3) post initial status page notice. Who can draft the status page blurb?
jess (comms): I can draft. Want the wording to match internal customer message — will post options below. We should avoid promising ETA.
lia (incident-commander): Nate, support triage — are customers opening tickets? Any high-touch customers impacted?
nate (support): Seeing ~12 open tickets, two flagged as paying-enterprise. Both report timeouts and are in US-EAST. Were prioritizing.
samir (oncall): Workaround: routing fallback to smaller model variant seems to reduce errors but increases latency. I can enable as temporary mitigation. Thoughts?
mike (infra): Do it. Enable fallback policy for the affected pool, scale +2 nodes. Ill watch resource pressure.
samir (oncall): Enabled fallback at 11:17 UTC and scaled pool. Error rate dropped by ~60% in metrics. Partial mitigation in place.
incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> partial (11:22 UTC)
lia (incident-commander): Good. Jess, please draft the status page update and the customer-facing email. Keep messaging consistent: acknowledge the issue, impact (timeouts for long requests in US-EAST), mitigation (fallback + scale), and next steps (root cause investigation + follow-up). Include link to support.
jess (comms): Draft 1 for status page (short):
```
Were currently experiencing increased errors for long (>=1k token) requests in the US‑EAST region.
Impact: Some requests may time out or return 5xx errors.
Mitigation: We have enabled fallback routing and increased capacity, which has reduced error rates.
Next update: We will provide additional details within 60 minutes.
Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1795032467
```

elena (engops): sgtm. Keep it factual, no technical blame. Also include a short customer email for enterprise teams.
jess (comms): Customer email draft: 
```
Subject: Service disruption affecting long generation requests (US‑EAST)
Hi —
Were reaching out to let you know were investigating an issue affecting long-generation requests (>=1k tokens) in our US‑EAST region. Some requests may time out or return errors. We have enabled routing fallbacks and scaled capacity to reduce impact; error rates are down.
Well follow up with a full incident report and timeline. If youre experiencing critical impact, please reply to this message or open a support case and well escalate immediately.
Best,
Redwood Inference Status Team
```

samir (oncall): One ask: include a short workaround for customers who can tolerate higher latency: switch to model-variant:v2-short or lower max_tokens. Could add in support doc link.
jess (comms): Good call. Adding one-liner and link to support doc.
lia (incident-commander): For public social: we need two short options — conservative and optimistic. Must be consistent with status page text and cleared by legal if we mention SLAs. Jess please post variants.
jess (comms): Tweet option A (conservative):
```
Were aware of elevated errors affecting long generation requests in US‑EAST. Weve applied mitigations to reduce impact and will post updates on our status page: https://status.redwood.ai
```
Tweet option B (slightly more op):
```
Investigating errors for long-generation requests in US‑EAST. Mitigations in place; customers should see reduced errors. More details on our status page and in support.
```

legal-bot: Reminder: avoid language promising "full service restoration" or specific ETA without SRE signoff.
jess (comms): Noted — will avoid ETA. We should also hold social until we have a second status page update confirming sustained improvement for 30 minutes. Agree?
elena (engops): Agree. Well wait for sustained metrics. Samir, can you ping this thread when error rate back to normal for 30m?
samir (oncall): Will do. Current error rate dropped to ~40% of peak after fallback. Monitoring.
lia (incident-commander): Handoff note: If IC changes, add "IC handoff" message here and update incident-bot.
incident-bot: Handoff template: 
```
IC Handoff: new_ic_name — reason for handoff — checkpoint notes — outstanding actions
```

jess (comms): Also drafting internal comms to Customer Success and Sales: short bullets + suggested FAQ replies for tiered customers.
jess (comms): Internal comms sample: 
```
Heads up: were experiencing timeouts for long-generation requests in US‑EAST. Mitigation active (fallback+scale). Enterprise customers flagged and being contacted. Support doc: https://redwood.ai/docs/troubleshoot-long-requests
Suggested reply: "Were actively mitigating and have reduced error rates; we will follow up with an incident report."
```

nate (support): Support team will use the suggested reply and prioritize flagged customers. Ill post examples of tickets in #support-ops if escalation needed.
mike (infra): Quick infra note: were rolling a kernel patch to the pool to harden against the oom pattern, but that will require a rolling restart — planning after traffic stabilizes.
samir (oncall): Error rates holding but Ill notify after 30m of stability or if it regresses.
jess (comms): If stable for 30m we post status page follow-up: short update saying errors reduced and were verifying. Then post tweet A. Legal will review tweet copy if we add any SLA mentions.
lia (incident-commander): Final checklist before public post: 1) 30m stable metrics 2) IC signoff 3) Comms copy approved by product-marketing/comms 4) legal ok if necessary 5) support queued with canned responses. Assign who posts: Elena will update status page, Jess will post social, Nate will coordinate support replies.
elena (engops): I will post the status page follow-up when Samir confirms 30m.
jess (comms): Ill stand by for social post. Please cc me in status update so copy matches.
samir (oncall): Noted — Ill post a brief metric note here at 11:47 UTC (30m window started ~11:17).
incident-bot: Note: next automated reminder set for 11:47 UTC to check stability.
lia (incident-commander): Thanks team. Keep actions tight. Well collect timeline for postmortem once RCAs start.
